column1: There's nothing to read on it.
The Meteor has control of your computer\001and he won't let you save the game.
column2: 隕石控制了你的電腦，\001它不讓你存檔。

column1: Hello, and welcome to Maniac Mansion,\001an exciting new game from Lucasfilm.
column2: 哈囉，歡迎來到《瘋狂大樓》，\001Lucasfilm 令人興奮的全新遊戲。

column1: I'm Dave Miller, your personal guide\001and one of the stars of the adventure.
column2: 我是戴夫・米勒，你的專屬導遊，\001也是這場冒險的主角之一。

column1: Here's where Sandy was held captive,\001and where we rescued her from Dr. Fred.
column2: 珊蒂就是被關在這裡，\001我們也在這裡把她從佛瑞德博士手中救出。

column1: I've arranged for the occupants to be\001gone during our `tour.`\003We shouldn't have any problems.
column2: 我已經安排住戶在我們「導覽」時\001都不在家。\003應該不會有問題。

column1: Oh. That was a `cut-scene.`\003They let you know what's\001going on elsewhere in the mansion.
column2: 喔，那是「過場動畫」。\003它會告訴你大樓其他地方\001正在發生什麼事。

column1: All these tours make me hungry.
column2: 導覽這麼多趟讓我餓了。

column1: I see they haven't cleaned up the, er,\001uh, um... the mess yet.
column2: 看來他們還沒清掉那個，呃，\001嗯……那攤東西。

column1: I think I just lost my appetite.
I know, let's go to my favorite room,\001the basement.
column2: 有了，我們去我最喜歡的房間，\001地下室。

column1: Now how did I open this door last time?\003Push it?
column2: 上次我是怎麼開這扇門的？\003用推的？

column1: Nope. Maybe I need a running start.
Oh well, I'll let you figure it out.
column2: 好吧，這個就留給你自己想。

column1: Hi Sandy, could you turn the music down?
column2: 嗨珊蒂，可以把音樂關小聲嗎？

column1: I'm sorry Dave, I couldn't hear you,\003the music was too loud.
column2: 抱歉戴夫，我聽不見你講話，\003音樂太大聲了。

column1: I was just giving a tour to all these\001future game players. Want to come?
column2: 我正在幫這些未來的玩家\001導覽。要一起來嗎？

column1: Sure Dave, I'll go anywhere with you!
column2: 好啊戴夫，我跟你去哪裡都行！

column1: Oh yes, in Maniac Mansion,\003you not only direct my actions,\001but the actions of two of my friends.
column2: 喔對了，在《瘋狂大樓》裡，\003你不只指揮我的行動，\001還要指揮我兩個朋友。

column1: Push   Open    Walk to  Unlock  Turn on
Pull   Close   Pick up  New kid Turn off
Give   Read    What is  Use     Fix
You point to the verbs you see below to\001construct sentences.
column2: 你用下面看到的指令\001來造句。

column1: It's one of the many rooms in the game.
column2: 這是遊戲裡眾多房間之一。

column1: And there are more than 450 objects...
column2: 而且有超過 450 個物品……

column1: ...that you can use to solve over...
Oh, Mom! I asked you not to call me\001at work.
column2: 喔，媽！我說過上班時間\001不要打給我。

column1: Oh great! Not again!!\003Time to round up the Gang.
column2: 真好！又來了！！\003該把大家召集起來了。

column1: Ok! This looks like the old mansion.
column2: 好！這看起來就是那棟老大樓。

column1: I'm sure I saw Dr. Fred take Sandy here.\003It's up to us to get her out.
column2: 我確定看到佛瑞德博士把珊蒂帶來這裡。\003現在要靠我們把她救出來。

column1: This could be real dangerous.\003If anyone wants to back out^
column2: 這可能真的很危險。\003如果有人想退出^

column1: BERNARD! Don't be a tuna head!\003It's Sandy we're talking about!
column2: 伯納！別耍笨了！\003我們說的是珊蒂啊！

column1: I heard Dr. Fred was kinda cute.
column2: 聽說佛瑞德博士還挺帥的。

column1: I thought we were going to the beach!
Did any of you guys see that movie?\003Four kids went into this strange house\003and...uh...never mind.
column2: 你們有人看過那部電影嗎？\003四個小孩走進一棟怪房子\003然後……呃……算了。

column1: How long do we have to stay down here?
column2: 我們還要在下面待多久？

column1: Shh... I think I hear something!
Quiet! I think I hear someone upstairs!
column2: 安靜！我好像聽到樓上有人！

column1: Oh great! Who forgot to lock the door?
Go upstairs and check it out!
I really DO miss my hamster!
the animation and graphics are superb^
